candidates.caption:
The bed has a rectangular shape and is covered with a blue comforter.

Next to the bed, there is a black bench under the bed. There are also two black nightstands next to the bed, one on each side. On top of each nightstand, there is a lamp with a white lampshade.

The bed has a rectangular shape and is covered in a blue quilted comforter. It is next to a black bench, which is under the bed. The bed also has multiple pillows, including gray and patterned ones, arranged on top of the comforter.

The bed has a dark brown wooden headboard with a decorative, slatted design. It is covered with a light-colored comforter featuring a pattern of blue and white sea-themed motifs, such as anchors and shells. The bed is rectangular in shape.

On top of the bed are several pillows: one is a dark blue square pillow with a white anchor design, another is a brown textured pillow, and others are white or off-white. The bed is next to a window with sheer white curtains. A ceiling fan with wooden blades and a white light fixture is above the bed. On the wall behind the headboard, there is a teal-colored accent wall with black lettering that reads "Be Our Guest". A long, narrow horizontal piece of artwork in blue and white hangs on the wall above the window. The bed is also next to a white door.

The bed has a dark brown wooden frame with a rectangular shape. The bedding is colorful and patchwork-style, featuring various patterns including soccer balls.

Next to the bed, there is a black wire pet crate on the floor. Under the bed, there is a small brown object on the carpet.

notes: Same house as bed_ep152. c0 and c1 are the same master bed (blue-gray pintuck comforter, dark leather bench at the foot, black rug); c1's single wide view also shows a second, damask-covered bed in the back, but the prominent bed is the master bed and the MLLM caption (blue quilted comforter next to a black bench) matches it, so c1 is labeled as the master bed. c3 (target) has one view through a doorway; the bed is small but clearly the soccer patchwork bed of the target photo. Answer check (Claude): Q1 'black bench under bed' = No is correct: the target bed has no bench at its foot (storage drawers only). Q2 'brown textured pillow on bed' = No is correct: its pillows are a soccer-ball pillow, plaid and navy patterned shams; the brown fuzzy pillow belongs to the nautical bed (c2). Log pruning matches the truth table: Q1 leaves {c2,c3}, Q2 leaves {c3}. ProCompNav ended via PBP_FALLBACK_SINGLE_CANDIDATE. Master-bed pillows are gray, cream and greige (not brown), so the brown-pillow truth is false for c0/c1.
